about_page.title: Real estate isn't sold. It's entrusted.
about_page.intro: MAPA Property — Luxembourg real estate agency and international broker. Under mandate, within a framework, in your sole interest.
about_page.para_1: There are transactions that happen in the light. And then there are those that are tied up in silence. For nearly a decade, MAPA Property has operated in the shadow of the most beautiful Luxembourg and international real estate transactions. Few of us know about it. And that's exactly how it should be.
about_page.para_2: It all started in 2018, in the corridors of a demanding financial environment. There, Julien Brebion learned a discipline: precision, discretion, the finely tuned reading of interests. When he founded MAPA Property in 2020 in Luxembourg, those three words became a method.
about_page.para_3: Like the American buyer's agent who has defended the buyer alone for decades, we believe the best real estate service is built on a search mandate. Not a broker serving two masters. Advice that defends only one interest at a time. This American evidence, we have made it our own.
about_page.para_4: We work with the tools of our time. Artificial intelligence is our daily ally — to analyse, structure, anticipate. But it never replaces an advisor's eye in a room. Our craft is the meeting. The rest is just technology.
about_page.para_5: Working together matters. Protecting each party's interests with a clear framework matters more. Signed mandate, defined missions, contractual confidentiality. This is how we build the best partnerships. And it's what explains our effectiveness.
about_page.para_6: We have been here for nearly a decade. We have supported several hundred clients — international families, executives, institutional investors, family offices. Most would tell you they never saw us in the light. That is precisely the service they came looking for.
about_page.para_7: MAPA Property is today a Luxembourg real estate agency and an international broker. We cover 24 municipalities in the Grand Duchy and 28 premium cities worldwide. We operate under mandate, within a framework, and always in our clients' sole interest. We can of course extend our search field on request, depending on our clients' needs and on the partners we may engage — always carefully selected, in full alignment with our standards and our vision of service.
about_page.bio_julien: I am the co-founder of MAPA Property and my role is Real Estate Director and also Exclusive Sourcing Specialist.

mentions_acquisition.meta_title: Legal notice — Real estate acquisition cost simulator | MAPA Property
mentions_acquisition.meta_description: Legal information and limitations of the MAPA Property acquisition cost simulator.
mentions_acquisition.title: Acquisition cost simulator — Full legal notice
mentions_acquisition.intro: The real estate acquisition cost simulator provided by MAPA Property is a decision-support tool. The notices below set out its scope, limitations and the legal framework applicable to its use.
mentions_acquisition.s1_body: The estimates produced by the simulator are based on the compilation of official public sources (tax administrations, notarial chambers, regulatory authorities, ministries of finance and equivalent bodies) in the nine covered countries. All sources are identified and time-stamped within the simulator interface. The most recent global verification date is 12 May 2026. Rates, allowances, scales and thresholds may evolve between two verifications without MAPA Property being informed in real time.
mentions_acquisition.s2_body: The figures displayed are strictly indicative. They do not constitute an offer, a commitment, or any form of tax, legal, notarial, financial or investment advice. They may not be relied upon as binding against MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl or any of its representatives. No document generated by the simulator has any evidentiary or contractual value before a notary, tax authority, bank or court.
mentions_acquisition.s3_body: The simulator covers nine countries: Luxembourg, France, Belgium, Germany, Monaco, Switzerland, Italy, Spain and Portugal. Costs included are registration / transfer duties, regulated notarial fees, VAT applicable to new-build, and the main common-law allowances (first-time buyer, primary residence, family profile). Excluded are: agency fees, technical diagnostics, annual local taxes, condominium charges, loan interest, insurance, banking fees, currency conversion, the buyer's personal taxation (IR, IFI, capital gains) and any post-acquisition costs. Regional variability (German Länder, Spanish autonomous communities, Belgian regions, Swiss cantons) is integrated at the finest available granularity but remains indicative. Real estate regulation evolves frequently: a check with a locally licensed notary at the effective transaction date is essential.
mentions_acquisition.s4_title: 4. Limitation of liability — MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl
mentions_acquisition.s4_body: MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl (LBR B241974, VAT LU 31988923, AE N°10108681/0-1-2-3, registration number 2020 2407 901), operating the MAPA Property PROPERTY brand, together with its directors, employees, partners and service providers, expressly declines any civil, tax or criminal liability with respect to the accuracy, completeness, availability or timeliness of the information displayed by the simulator, and with respect to acquisition, financing or investment decisions made on the basis of these estimates. No claim for damages may be brought against MAPA SYNERGY Sàrl on this basis.
mentions_acquisition.s5_body: The user acknowledges that use of the simulator does not in any way release them from the MANDATORY consultation of a locally licensed notary in the country of acquisition, as well as, where applicable, of an independent tax advisor and a specialised lawyer. Any binding decision (signing of a preliminary contract, payment of a deposit, loan application, tax declaration) must rely on contradictory figures provided by these professionals and not on the simulator's estimates.
mentions_acquisition.s6_body: For a personalised, contradictory and secured analysis of your acquisition project, MAPA Property makes available its network of partner notaries, tax advisors and lawyers in the nine covered countries. Our scope of intervention extends from the Luxembourg trophy asset to international wealth investment, under a signed search mandate.

full.p1: The estimates, simulations, market analyses and data presented on this site are provided for informational and indicative purposes. They rely on public sources (STATEC, Observatoire de l'Habitat, ABBL, Central Bank of Luxembourg) and on MAPA Property's proprietary algorithms.
full.p2: MAPA Property accepts no liability for any use that may be made of this information, for decisions taken on its basis, or for any discrepancies with market reality or the user's individual situation.
full.p3: This data does not constitute financial, tax, legal or notarial advice. For any concrete transaction, consult the relevant professionals: notary (authentic deed, inheritance, matrimonial regime), bank or licensed credit broker (financing), tax adviser (taxation, capital gains), lawyer (legal advice).
